description: Server-to-server EVENT requests to s2s.singular.net/api/v1/evt and /api/v2/evt, as form or query parameters. JSON bodies are not this API.

params.name: a
params.description: It is the Singular SDK Key, not the Reporting API Key, and every EVENT request requires it.
params.fix_hint: Send the SDK Key as `a`.

params.name: p
params.description: It is the platform, case-sensitive. Singular documents the values Android, iOS, Web, PC, Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo, MetaQuest, and CTV.
params.fix_hint: Set `p` to the documented platform spelling, such as `iOS`.

params.name: i
params.description: It is the app identifier, case-sensitive, and every EVENT request requires it.
params.fix_hint: Send the app ID as `i`.

params.name: n
params.description: It is the event name, at most 32 ASCII characters, and every EVENT request requires it.
params.fix_hint: Set `n` to an event name of 32 ASCII characters or fewer.

params.name: ip
params.description: It is the public device IP. Singular requires `ip` or `use_ip`, and they are mutually exclusive.
params.fix_hint: Send the device IPv4 as `ip`, or send `use_ip` instead.

params.name: use_ip
params.description: It tells Singular to use the request IP. Mutually exclusive with `ip`.

params.name: sdid
params.description: It is the Singular device ID, a UUIDv4. V2 requires it. New accounts as of 15 July 2026 must use V2.
params.fix_hint: On `/api/v2/evt`, send `sdid` as a UUIDv4.

params.name: cur
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code, uppercase, used with `amt` on revenue events.
params.fix_hint: Send `cur` as `USD` together with `amt`.

params.name: amt
params.description: It is the revenue amount. Singular documents a number used with `cur`. Sending it makes the call a revenue event.
params.fix_hint: Send `amt` as a number such as `2.51`, together with `cur`.

params.name: idfa
params.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Advertisers. Singular documents a UUIDv4 on EVENT V1. Omit it when unavailable. Never send an empty string.
params.fix_hint: Send `idfa` as a UUID, or omit the pair.

params.name: idfv
params.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Vendor. Singular documents a UUIDv4, required on iOS V1 regardless of ATT.
params.fix_hint: Send `idfv` as a UUID on iOS V1.

params.name: aifa
params.description: It is the Google advertising ID. Singular documents a UUIDv4 on Google Play V1.
params.fix_hint: Send `aifa` as a UUID, or omit the pair off Google Play.

params.name: asid
params.description: It is the Android App Set ID. Singular documents a UUIDv4 on Google Play V1.
params.fix_hint: Send `asid` as a UUID on Google Play V1.

params.name: amid
params.description: It is the Amazon advertising ID. Singular documents a UUIDv4 for Fire devices.
params.fix_hint: Send `amid` as a UUID on Amazon devices, or omit the pair.

params.name: oaid
params.description: It is the Open Advertising Identifier on Chinese OEM Android. Singular documents a UUID, but the published example is not a valid UUID, so only emptiness is checked.
params.fix_hint: Send `oaid` when the device has no Google Play, or omit the pair.

params.name: andi
params.description: It is the Android ID. Singular documents it only when no other identifier is available and the app is not on Google Play.
params.fix_hint: Send `andi` only off Google Play when AIFA and ASID are unavailable.

params.name: ve
params.description: It is the OS version at event time. Singular documents it on EVENT requests.
params.fix_hint: Send `ve` as the OS version, such as `9.2`.

params.name: ua
params.description: It is the device user agent. Singular documents it URL-encoded and unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the raw user agent as `ua`.

params.name: lc
params.description: It is the IETF locale as `ll_CC`. Singular documents the plain form, with no Unicode extensions.
params.fix_hint: Send `lc` as `en_US`.

params.name: country
params.description: It is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Singular documents it when `use_ip=true` or no IP is available.
params.fix_hint: Send a two-letter code such as `US`.

params.name: c
params.description: It is the network connection type. Singular documents `wifi` or `carrier`.
params.fix_hint: Send `c` as `wifi` or `carrier`.

params.name: att_authorization_status
params.description: It is the iOS ATT status. Singular documents 0 undetermined, 1 restricted, 2 denied, 3 authorized.
params.fix_hint: Send `0`, `1`, `2`, or `3`. Pass `0` when ATT is not implemented.

params.name: utime
params.description: It is the event time as a 10-digit Unix timestamp.
params.fix_hint: Send `utime` as 10-digit Unix seconds, such as `1483228800`.

params.name: umilisec
params.description: It is the event time as a 13-digit Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
params.fix_hint: Send `umilisec` as 13-digit Unix milliseconds, such as `1483228800000`.

params.name: is_revenue_event
params.description: It marks a revenue event. Singular still treats the event as revenue when `amt` is present.
params.fix_hint: Send `true` or `false`. Omit `amt` if the event is not revenue.

params.name: ma
params.description: It is the device make. Singular documents it together with `mo`.
params.fix_hint: Send `ma` and `mo` together, such as `Apple` and `iPhone 4S`.

params.name: mo
params.description: It is the device model. Singular documents it together with `ma`.
params.fix_hint: Send `ma` and `mo` together.

params.name: e
params.description: It is a JSON object of custom event attributes, URL-encoded. Singular documents a JSON object.
params.fix_hint: Send a JSON object such as `{"sng_attr_content_id":5581}`, URL-encoded.

rules.message: The request has neither `ip` nor `use_ip`. Singular requires one of them on every EVENT.
rules.fix_hint: Send the device IP as `ip`, or send `use_ip` to use the request address.

rules.message: The request sends both `ip` and `use_ip`. Singular documents them as mutually exclusive.
This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Singular documents `ip` and `ua` as unhashed device values.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent.

rules.message: The request has no device identifier. EVENT V2 requires `sdid`. V1 requires at least one of `idfa`, `idfv`, `aifa`, `asid`, `amid`, `oaid`, or `andi`.
rules.fix_hint: On `/api/v2/evt` send `sdid`. On `/api/v1/evt` send a platform advertising ID.

rules.message: The event sends `amt` without `cur`. Singular documents the ISO 4217 code together with the amount.
rules.fix_hint: Add `cur` as a three-letter uppercase code such as `USD`.

rules.message: The request sends `ma` without `mo`. Singular documents make and model together.
The request sends `mo` without `ma`. Singular documents make and model together.
`use_ip=true` is missing `country`. Singular documents a two-letter country code when it cannot geolocate from `ip`.
rules.fix_hint: Send `country` as a two-letter code such as `US`.
